**Ryu Asada** was a Japanese Hot Wheels designer who worked at Mattel from 2004 to 2021 and oversaw the design of cars in the basic $1 mainline lineup as a Designer Project Lead, taking over from [Jun Imai](/wiki/Jun_Imai). Born in Osaka, he pursued a degree at the Art Center College of Design after emigrating to the United States. After graduating, he initially began work as a designer for [Matchbox](/wiki/Matchbox) from 2004 to 2012; he first designed for Hot Wheels in 2009 as a "guest designer", and would join the Hot Wheels design team three years later.

He passed away on 23 March 2021 at the age of 42 from cancer. A mini-segment of the 2022 mainline, dubbed **Ryu's Rides**, as well as the [Ryu Asada Award](/wiki/2021_Hot_Wheels_Legends_Tour) for the 2021 Hot Wheels Legends Tour, were both created to celebrate his life and to honor his legacy.
